title: rompelia polymorpha

The leaves and stems of Rompelia polymorpha have been traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Rompelia polymorpha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
